instruction: Symbol Recovery After Library Rename The files `design.kicad_sch`, `/home/user/Desktop/sym-lib-table`, and `legacy.kicad_sym` form a KiCad 9 schematic project for five LM2596 buck-converter channels. The schematic references a project library that has been renamed to `power_ic`; update the schematic and library table so every LM2596 instance resolves through `power_ic:LM2596`, provide the renamed library file, and export the repaired sheet as an SVG. Requirements: 1. Update every `Legacy:LM2596` lib_id reference in the schematic to `power_ic:LM2596`. 2. Update `/home/user/Desktop/sym-lib-table` so the project library entry is named exactly `power_ic` and its URI points to `/home/user/Desktop/power_ic.kicad_sym`; remove the stale Legacy entry. 3. Provide `/home/user/Desktop/power_ic.kicad_sym` as the renamed project symbol library file. Its LM2596 symbol definition should match the original legacy.kicad_sym content. 4. Do not modify any other symbols or their properties. 5. Export the repaired schematic sheet as `/home/user/Desktop/design.svg` from KiCad. Write `design.kicad_sch`, `/home/user/Desktop/sym-lib-table`, `/home/user/Desktop/power_ic.kicad_sym`, and `/home/user/Desktop/design.svg`. [Software] To use KiCad, run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path).
